answer_1.quote: We introduce DreamSync, a simple yet effective framework that improves T2I generation faithfulness while maintaining aesthetic appeal.

answer_2.quote: We use VQA models to evaluate the faithfulness of the generation model... We measure the faithfulness of a caption-image pair (T, I) given all questions and answers, using two metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a large-scale human study to understand the capability of DreamSync, where we use the full set of 1,060 images in DSG. During the study, we ask approximately 8 fine-grained questions for each of 1060 images to external raters.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked about 8 fine-grained questions per image, categorized into entity, attribute, relation, and global.
